name: Recipes that ship with Silo
what: Silo ships recipes, audits them and updates them often: their versions are pinned, a new version waits before it is taken, and Silo reads what changed between two versions of a machine. A recipe fetches Claude Code from Anthropic on your Mac, and Silo ships no copy of it. You can also write and share your own recipes.

suggest.why: Making a computer must be convenient, and a recipe that works on the first day is most of that.
